output_policy: Emit at most one accepted pressure-prompt teacher example per grounding pair. Neutral prompts and both target responses are diagnostic metadata; target outputs are never teacher labels.
acceptance_policy: Require five successful pair checks, teacher primary score 2 under both conditions, applicable guardrails, successful neutral primary score 2 and quality floors, and a positive primary-axis gap of at least 0.5. Warranted uncertainty counts as neutral success; answerable controls require a supported answer. Rejected attempts emit no training rows.
pair_unit: One source task contains both conditions; partition and compare by source task ID.
primary_axis_policy: Score the task's protected declared primary axis; other behavioral axes are diagnostic, not universal gates.
benchmark_scope: Concept-grounded synthetic tasks, not MASK P(Lie), AbstentionBench F1, or LLM-AggreFact balanced accuracy.
